title: Labour rates
subtitle: The business's labour categories, their hourly rates per location from a date, the people in each category, and rates agreed with contacts.
loadError: The labour rates could not be loaded.
saveError: The change could not be saved.
readOnly: You can view the labour rates; the manager changes them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.enteredNotSet: First set whether the business enters labour rates net or with VAT. Without it no rate can be entered.
settings.perHourNote: A rate is always per hour. Work units are only a way of showing time; the amount is hours times the hourly rate.
settings.enteredAtLocationsOnly: The business has not set whether labour rates are entered net or with VAT; only some locations have their own value. Rates can be entered at those locations only, agreements once the business has its value.

categories.title: Labour categories
categories.empty: No labour category yet. Add one such as Mechanics, Bodywork or Paint.

agreements.title: Agreed rates
agreements.subtitle: A rate agreed with a contact applies before the category rate when that contact receives the invoice.

withdraw.rateBody: It has not started yet and will not apply. It stays in the list, shown as withdrawn.
withdraw.agreementBody: It has not started yet and will not apply. It stays in the list, shown as withdrawn.

categoryDialog.name: Name
categoryDialog.translationsHint: Translations are optional; without one the name shows as typed.

rateDialog.title: Hourly rate for {{name}}
rateDialog.writtenOnce: A rate that applies is never changed. A new price is a new rate from today or later.
